BL-1612 — The two readers that supply a sender's received commit to the send-time gates read the in_process box flat, so for the cleaner and hardender - whose parcels sit inside batch directories - BL-806's review-forward evidence gate, BL-1576's merge-drop gate and BL-1213's parcel-rollback gate find no received commit and stay silent on every send; both readers descend into batch directories the way BL-1313 taught the sender's own non-forwarding check, and a batch role is judged exactly as a task role
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: only the two readers' file listing changes - `handoff-lib/handoff-files` becomes `handoff-lib/handoff-files-with-batches` (BL-1313's reader), the newest-match rule and the fail-open sha…
